field.label: OpenVPN instance
field.help: The OpenVPN server instance to protect with SSO. The instance must have 'management-client-auth' in its various flags and no authentication backend configured.

field.label: Provider
field.help: OIDC provider profile. Use 'Microsoft Entra ID' unless connecting a different IdP.

field.label: Tenant ID
field.help: Entra ID directory (tenant) GUID; used to derive the issuer URL.

field.label: Client ID
field.help: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration.

field.label: Client secret
field.help: Client secret of the app registration. Note the expiry date: Entra secrets are valid for at most 24 months.

field.label: Scopes
field.help: Space-separated OIDC scopes requested from the provider.

field.label: Allowed groups
field.help: Entra ID group object IDs allowed to connect. Empty allows every authenticated user.

field.label: Match certificate CN
field.help: Require the client certificate common name to match the authenticated user.

field.label: Match IP address
field.help: Require the browser session and the VPN client to come from the same IP address.

field.label: Pending-auth timeout (s)
field.help: How long a client may take to finish the browser login.

field.label: Public base URL
field.help: URL the user's browser reaches the firewall on, e.g. https://vpn.example.nl:9000 — must match DNS and the certificate, and be registered as redirect URI base in Entra.

field.label: Listen address
field.help: Local address the callback listener binds to.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: TCP port of the callback listener; remember the matching firewall rule.

field.label: Enable TLS
field.help: Serve the callback listener over HTTPS (required by several VPN clients).

field.label: Certificate
field.help: Server certificate from the OPNsense trust store for the HTTPS listener.

field.label: GUI status pass-through
field.help: Keep VPN → OpenVPN → Connection Status working by proxying the management socket. Disable ("exclusive mode") only if the socket swap misbehaves.
